[[File:MarcoForelli-GTASA.jpg|thumb|The character who was to be Marco Forelli in the mission Saint Mark's Bistro.]]
'''Marco Forelli''' was to be a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. The character remains in the game but is unnamed, although audio and text files with his name remain<ref>''text\american.gxt>CASIN10>CAS11ED>''Marco Forelli, I'm here for you!</ref>.

==Character history==
Forelli was to be a high-ranking [[Forelli Family]] mobster based in [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]], who protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] is sent to kill on the orders of [[Salvatore Leone]], [[Gang Leaders|Don]] of the [[Leone Family]]. He may have been the successor to [[Sonny Forelli]], who was killed in [[Keep Your Friends Close...]] in [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]].

==Mission appearance==
;GTA San Andreas
*[[Saint Mark's Bistro]] <small>'''(Killed)'''</small>
